text:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished for release v2.18.4 -> us-west-2. Canary 5% started. Running post-deploy checks: healthgate, latency probes, KV warmup.

Anya: seeing a heartbeat gap on the canary probes, p95 spiked to ~420ms (baseline ~120ms). A couple of hosts returning intermittent 503s.

Marcus: quick trace shows a high KV miss rate on infer-05 and infer-07. Config hash mismatch on those hosts vs the rest (build id matches).

Jess: suggestion: hold the rollout at 5%, run an expanded synthetic smoke across 10 hosts in the region while we investigate. Don't roll forward until we have green.

Ryan: +1 to hold. Also please pause autoscaling for the affected pool to avoid noisy-neighbor effects during recovery.

deploy-bot: Placing rollout on HOLD at 5% per request from @Jess. Use /deploy resume when ready.

Anya: sharing quick logs from infer-05:```
[2026-03-20T16:04:12Z] health-check failed: backend timeout=5001ms host=infer-05
[2026-03-20T16:04:13Z] kv-warmup miss_ratio=0.87 host=infer-05
[2026-03-20T16:04:13Z] request_id=abcd1234 latency=430ms status=503
```

Marcus: found stale serving config on those boxes: /etc/redwood/serving.yaml had batching=false while the release expects batching=true. Looks like the node config agent didn't pick up the new template on two hosts.

Jess: recovery plan: 1) fix serving.yaml on affected hosts, 2) restart the serving process, 3) run full synthetic smoke (10 hosts), 4) if smoke green, resume to 20% then continue rollout; 5) if issues persist, rollback to v2.18.3.

Ryan: ETA ~12m to patch and restart via ops-automation. I'll also temporarily disable scale-up for the pool.

deploy-bot: Note: resume command available: `/deploy resume --percent 5 --to 20` once you confirm smoke green.

infra-bot: Created incident INC-2026-0320 for post-deploy health drift and attached runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/postdeploy-health-drift.

Anya: kicking off the smoke run: `/scripts/postdeploy/smoke-run --release v2.18.4 --region us-west-2 --targets 10`

Marcus: opened follow-up ticket to detect config drift in the node agent: https://issues.redwood.ai/RED-4123 (assign infra).

Ryan: patched serving.yaml on infer-05 and infer-07 and restarted the service. Restart logs look good.

deploy-bot: Health checks now passing on updated hosts. Canary remains on HOLD pending full smoke completion.

Anya: Smoke run finished: 10/10 checks passed. p95 ~110ms, errors 0.

Jess: OK to resume rollout. Resume to 20% and monitor for 15m, then proceed to wider rollout within the change window (until 00:00 UTC).

Ryan: Resuming now: `/deploy resume --from 5 --to 20`

deploy-bot: Rollout advanced to 20%. Monitoring for 15m. Notifications sent to #eng-oncall.

Jess: Please add a blurb to release notes: "v2.18.4: NOTE — initial canary experienced transient post-deploy warmup on two hosts due to node config drift; fixed and rollout resumed. If you see transient increased latency during immediate post-deploy warmup, wait ~15m for KV warmup to stabilize."

Marcus: added the infra follow-up and labeled it p2.

Ryan: leaving a note in the change window: patched hosts and resumed rollout.

Anya: closing thread once rollout reaches 100% or if any new regressions appear.
